description: This Java class 'DefaultStreamCacheConfig' provides configuration management for stream caching, including settings like dispatcher name, retry delay, and cache parameters. It implements the StreamCacheConfig interface and uses the Typesafe Config library for configuration handling.

classes.name: DefaultStreamCacheConfig
